imageQa.note: Intentional image-free layouts; no new or changed editorial, affiliate or product imagery. The pull-up bar guide uses accurate category text links only.

searchConsole.signal: Four homepage impressions, zero clicks, average position 1.5, no query rows and no supported non-homepage cluster
searchConsole.decision: The sample is too small and queryless to support a Data-led page. Today's portfolio therefore uses one authority expansion and two distinct explorations while strengthening crawl paths from established guides.
searchConsole.ignored: The four homepage impressions, the HTTP homepage variant and aggregate average position were deliberately ignored as insufficient evidence for keyword targeting, title changes or a topical pivot.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed, sponsored/nofollow category text recommendations appear only on the pull-up bar guide. The withholding and heated-apparel guides remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-worthy paycheck-withholding checkup record that preserves pay-period inputs, W-4 decisions, estimator output, supplemental-pay treatment, implementation checks and tax-season handoff without storing sensitive identifiers.
authority.cluster: Work-and-money authority, with reciprocal contextual paths from the job-offer, raise, checking-account and emergency-fund guides; seasonal outerwear and home-strength clusters gain reciprocal links as well.
authority.opportunity: Two qualified financial-education accuracy opportunities were logged for the National Association of Enrolled Agents and Consumer Action; no outreach sent.

diversity: The batch answers three different questions across Life, Style and Fitness: how to review federal withholding, how to judge a battery-heated garment, and how to select and install a pull-up bar. The authority record is noncommercial, the apparel guide separates garment and battery evidence, and the equipment guide alone serves purchase intent; none follows the weak Search Console sample.
